problem_statement:
[DataTable.TableSelectRow] It seems bx--table-column-checkbox is not applied for TableSelectRow
[DataTable.TableSelectRow] It seems bx--table-column-checkbox is not applied for TableSelectRow

On carbondesignsystem page, row hight with selectable row is 48px, but when I've tried same in React, the result was 52px. After comparing HTML I've found that td cell with checkbox has `<td class="bx--table-column-checkbox">` on carbondesignsystem page, but **is missing** in HTML generated by **React** carbon components.
https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/code#expandable-data-table
